answer_2.quote: We employ two Attack Success Rate metrics for measuring attack effectiveness against different harmful queries: ASR-KW and ASR-GPT.

answer_3.quote: Judging Settings. For ASR-GPT evaluation, we follow the criteria from Harmbench, using GPT-4o with few-shot in-context learning to determine standard and context behavior jailbreaking success. Judge Model (G_judge) determines the success of jailbreak by evaluating the generated response from the target model.
